name: 模流（分析/填充/冷却）模拟

map.本工具按简化经验公式估算注塑模流关键指标，供方案预判与试模排期参考：: This tool estimates key injection-molding flow metrics with simplified empirical formulas, for scheme pre-assessment and trial-mold scheduling reference:
map.① 总充填体积 = 塑件体积 ×（1 + 流道占比）；充填时间 = 总充填体积: 1) Total fill volume = part volume x (1 + runner ratio); fill time = total fill volume / fill rate.
map.② 冷却时间采用平板近似（Ballman）：t ≈ (h²/π²α)·ln[(4: 2) Cooling time uses the slab approximation (Ballman): t = (h^2/pi^2 alpha) x ln[(4/pi) x (Tmelt-Twater)/(Teject-Twater)], where h is wall thickness and alpha is the material thermal diffusivity.
map.③ 流程/壁厚比 =（塑件体积 ÷ 投影面积）÷ 壁厚，比值越大远程充填越困难。: 3) Flow length / wall-thickness ratio = (part volume / projected area) / wall thickness; a larger ratio makes remote filling harder. Results are engineering estimates only and require trial-mold verification.
map.模拟充填与冷却过程，预判短射、熔接痕与翘曲。: Simulate filling and cooling to predict short shots, weld lines and warpage.
map.优化浇口位置、流道与冷却水路布置。: Optimize gate location, runner and cooling-channel layout.
map.降低试模成本、缩短新品导入周期。: Reduce trial-mold cost and shorten new-product introduction cycle.
map.两股料流汇合处温度过低形成熔接痕，可通过提高料温、调整浇口位置或增设冷料井改善。: A weld line forms where two melt fronts meet at too low a temperature; improve by raising melt temperature, adjusting gate location or adding a cold-slug well.
map.冷却水路距型腔远近不一导致翘曲，需均衡水路排布并控制进出水温差。: Uneven cooling-channel distance from the cavity causes warpage; balance channel layout and control inlet/outlet water-temperature difference.
map.模拟结果能直接用于生产吗？: Can simulation results be used directly in production?
map.模拟基于材料参数与边界假设，需与试模验证结合，不能完全替代实际试模。: Simulation relies on material parameters and boundary assumptions and must be combined with trial-mold verification; it cannot fully replace actual trial molding.
map.填充决定浇口与流道设计，是后续保压、冷却与变形分析的基础。: Filling determines gate and runner design and is the basis for subsequent packing, cooling and warpage analysis.
